54761-children-of-men.title: Children Of Men
54761-children-of-men.creator: Bruno Lessing
54761-children-of-men.description: A book by Bruno Lessing. le wheels and cogs and levers and ratchets, and each part tries to pound, scrape, squeak and bang and roar louder than all the others. The old man who went crazy last year in this very same shop used to sit in the cell where they chained him, with his fingers in his ears, to keep out the noise of the sewing-machines.

arxiv-1809-00659.title: Barriers in Seamless QoS for Mobile Applications
arxiv-1809-00659.creator: Mohammad A. Hoque, Hassan Abbas, Tong Li, Yong Li, Pan Hui, Sasu Tarkoma
arxiv-1809-00659.description: Abstract For seamless QoS, it is important that all the stakeholders, such as the hosts, applications, access networks, routers, and other middleboxes, follow a single protocol and they trust each other. In this article, we investigate the participation of these entities in providing QoS over wireless networks in light of DiffServ QoS architecture.

arxiv-2110-08684.title: Absolutely continuous and pure point spectra of discrete operators with sparse potentials
arxiv-2110-08684.creator: S. Molchanov, O. Safronov, and B. Vainberg
arxiv-2110-08684.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Molchanov, O. Safronov, and B. Vainberg. We consider the discrete Schrödinger operator H = − Δ + V H=-\Delta+V with a sparse potential V V and find conditions guaranteeing either existence of wave operators for the pair H H and H 0 = − Δ H_{0}=-\Delta , or presence of dense purely point spectrum of the operator H H on some interval [ λ 0 , 0 ] [\lambda_{0},0] with λ 0 < 0 \lambda_{0}<0 .

arxiv-2203-10808.title: AnoViT: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection and Localization with Vision Transformer-based Encoder-Decoder
arxiv-2203-10808.creator: Yunseung Lee, Pilsung Kang
arxiv-2203-10808.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yunseung Lee, Pilsung Kang. Image anomaly detection problems aim to determine whether an image is abnormal, and to detect anomalous areas. These methods are actively used in various fields such as manufacturing, medical care, and intelligent information. Encoder-decoder structures have been widely used in the field of anomaly detection because they can easily learn normal patterns in an unsupervised learning environment and calculate a score to identify abnormalities through a reconstruction error indicating the difference between input and reconstructed images.

arxiv-2307-03760.title: CODAG: Characterizing and Optimizing Decompression Algorithms for GPUs
arxiv-2307-03760.creator: Jeongmin Park, Zaid Qureshi, Vikram Sharma Mailthody, Andrew Gacek, Shunfan Shao, Mohammad AlMasri, Isaac Gelado, Jinjun Xiong, Chris J Newburn, I-hsin Chung, Michael Garland, Nikolay Sakharnykh, Wen-mei Hwu
arxiv-2307-03760.description: Abstract Data compression and decompression have become vital components of big-data applications to manage the exponential growth in the amount of data collected and stored. Furthermore, big-data applications have increasingly adopted GPUs due to their high compute throughput and memory bandwidth.

arxiv-2309-02660.title: A Bi-level Globalization Strategy for Non-convex Consensus ADMM and ALADIN
arxiv-2309-02660.creator: Xu Du*, Jingzhe Wang, Xiaohua Zhou, Yijie Mao
arxiv-2309-02660.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xu Du*, Jingzhe Wang, Xiaohua Zhou, Yijie Mao. In this paper, we formally analyze global convergence in the realm of distributed consensus optimization. Current solutions have explored such analysis, particularly focusing on consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (C-ADMM), including convex and non-convex cases. While such efforts on non-convexity offer elegant theory guaranteeing global convergence, they entail strong assumptions and complicated proof techniques that are increasingly pose challenges when adopted to real-world applications.

arxiv-2309-10803.title: Phase space analysis of two-wavelength interferometry
arxiv-2309-10803.creator: Robert H. Leonard, Spencer E. Olson
arxiv-2309-10803.description: Abstract Multiple wavelength phase shifting interferometry is widely used to extend the UR ( UR ) beyond that of a single wavelength. Towards this end, many algorithms have been developed to calculate the OPD ( OPD ) from the phase measurements of multiple wavelengths. These algorithms fail when phase error exceeds a specific threshold.

arxiv-2410-10349.title: LLM-based Code-Switched Text Generation for Grammatical Error Correction
arxiv-2410-10349.creator: Tom Potter, Zheng Yuan
arxiv-2410-10349.description: Abstract With the rise of globalisation, code-switching (CSW) has become a ubiquitous part of multilingual conversation, posing new challenges for natural language processing (NLP), especially in Grammatical Error Correction (GEC). This work explores the complexities of applying GEC systems to CSW texts.

arxiv-2411-00554.title: Differentiable Physics-based System Identification for Robotic Manipulation of Elastoplastic Materials
arxiv-2411-00554.creator: Xintong Yang \affilnum 1, Ze Ji \affilnum 1, Yu-Kun Lai \affilnum 2
arxiv-2411-00554.description: Abstract Robotic manipulation of volumetric elastoplastic deformable materials, from foods such as dough to construction materials like clay, is in its infancy, largely due to the difficulty of modelling and perception in a high-dimensional space. Simulating the dynamics of such materials is computationally expensive.

arxiv-2412-15380.title: Uncertainty-Guided Cross Attention Ensemble Mean Teacher for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2412-15380.creator: Meghana Karri, Amit Soni Arya, Koushik Biswas, Nicolo Gennaro, Vedat Cicek, Gorkem Durak, Yury Velichko, Ulas Bagci
arxiv-2412-15380.description: Abstract This work proposes a novel framework, Uncertainty-Guided Cross Attention Ensemble Mean Teacher (UG-CEMT), for achieving state-of-the-art performance in semi-supervised medical image segmentation. UG-CEMT leverages the strengths of co-training and knowledge distillation by combining a Cross-attention Ensemble Mean Teacher framework (CEMT) inspired by Vision Transformers (ViT) with uncertainty-guided consistency regularization and Sharpness-Aware Minimization emphasizing uncertainty.

arxiv-2501-01731.title: Coherent control over the high-dimensional space of the nuclear spin of alkaline-earth atoms
arxiv-2501-01731.creator: H. Ahmed, A. Litvinov, P. Guesdon, E. Maréchal, J. H. Huckans, B. Pasquiou, B. Laburthe-Tolra, M. Robert-de-Saint-Vincent
arxiv-2501-01731.description: Abstract We demonstrate coherent manipulation of the nuclear degrees of freedom of ultracold ground-state strontium 87 atoms, thus providing a toolkit for fully exploiting the corresponding large Hilbert space as a quantum resource and for quantum simulation experiments with 𝔰 ​ 𝔲 \mathfrak{su} (N)-symmetric matter.

arxiv-2503-14605.title: A Million Three-body Binaries Caught by Gaia
arxiv-2503-14605.creator: Dany Atallah, Yonadav Barry Ginat, Newlin C. Weatherford
arxiv-2503-14605.description: Abstract Gaia observations have revealed over a million stellar binary candidates within ∼ 1 ​ kpc {\sim}1\,{\rm kpc} of the Sun, predominantly characterized by orbital separations > 10 3 ​ AU {>}10^{3}\,{\rm AU} and eccentricities > 0.7 {>}0.7 . The prevalence of such wide, eccentric binaries has proven challenging to explain through canonical binary formation channels.

arxiv-2505-17695.title: SynRES: Towards Referring Expression Segmentation in the Wild via Synthetic Data
arxiv-2505-17695.creator: Dong-Hee Kim Hyunjee Song Donghyun Kim Korea University {dongheekim, kelly062001, d_kim}@korea.ac.kr
arxiv-2505-17695.description: Abstract Despite the advances in Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) benchmarks, their evaluation protocols remain constrained, primarily focusing on either single targets with short queries (containing minimal attributes) or multiple targets from distinctly different queries on a single domain. This limitation significantly hinders the assessment of more complex reasoning capabilities in RES models.

openalex-w2964143382.title: Deletion of a Csf1r enhancer selectively impacts CSF1R expression and development of tissue macrophage populations
openalex-w2964143382.creator: Rocío Rojo, Anna Raper, Derya Deniz Ozdemir, Lucas Lefèvre, Kathleen Grabert, Evi Wollscheid-Lengeling, Barry Matthew Bradford, Melanie Caruso, Iveta Gažová, Alejandra Sánchez, Zofia M. Lisowski, Joana Alves

The mammalian Csf1r locus contains a highly conserved super-enhancer, the fms -intronic regulatory element...

plos-pone-0001146.title: Unexpected High Losses of Anopheles gambiae Larvae Due to Rainfall
plos-pone-0001146.creator: Krijn P. Paaijmans, Moses O. Wandago, Andrew K. Githeko et al.
plos-pone-0001146.description: PLOS ONE research article. Immature stages of the malaria mosquito Anopheles gambiae experience high mortality, but its cause is poorly understood. Here we study the impact of rainfall, one of the abiotic factors to which the immatures are frequently exposed, on their mortality. We show that rainfall signi

plos-pone-0011806.title: Extended LTA, TNF, LST1 and HLA Gene Haplotypes and Their Association with Rubella Vaccine-Induced Immunity
plos-pone-0011806.creator: Inna G. Ovsyannikova, Robert A. Vierkant, V. Shane Pankratz et al.
plos-pone-0011806.description: PLOS ONE research article. Recent studies have suggested the importance of HLA genes in determining immune responses following rubella vaccine. The telomeric class III region of the HLA complex harbors several genes, including lymphotoxin alpha (LTA), tumor necrosis factor (TNF) and leukocyte specific tran

pmc-11503300.title: Ophthalmic Use of Targeted Biologics in the Management of Intraocular Diseases: Current and Emerging Therapies
pmc-11503300.creator: Yuan Zong, Miki Miyagaki, Mingming Yang, Jing Zhang, Yaru Zou, Kyoko Ohno-Matsui, Koju Kamoi
pmc-11503300.description: Background: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) have demonstrated substantial potential in the treatment of intraocular diseases. This review aimed to comprehensively evaluate the applications, efficacy, and safety of mAbs in the management of intraocular conditions. Methods: A comprehensive literature search was conducted in major medical databases through July 2024. Relevant studies on monoclonal antibodies for intraocular diseases were included.

pmc-12535944.title: Efficacy of neurosurgical intervention in syrinx resolution in patients presenting with Chiari malformation type I and syringomyelia: a systematic review and radiological meta-analysis
pmc-12535944.creator: Adharsh Suraj Prasad, Aqif Farhan bin Azmil Farid, Isaac Tang Jing Wen, Thomas Zhang, Chandrasekaran Kaliaperumal
pmc-12535944.description: Neurosurgical techniques have been used to treat Chiari Malformation type 1 (CM1). However, there remains some uncertainty regarding which neurosurgical procedure is most efficacious in treating patients with CMI and syringomyelia. Our study aims to compare the efficacy of available neurosurgical techniques in resolving syrinx for patients with CM1 and syringomyelia.

pmc-12609072.title: Replacing Manual Operation with Bio-Automation II: Construction of a Biological Digestion Gene Circuit to Eliminate the Interference of Food Matrices in the Rapid Detection of Heavy Metals
pmc-12609072.creator: Shiqi Xia, Shijing Chen, Hongfei Su, Liangshu Hu, Xiaozhe Qi, Mingzhang Guo, Ewen C D Todd
pmc-12609072.description: Food matrices such as phytic acid, starch, and proteins can chelate heavy metals, acting as stabilizers that significantly hinder accurately detecting heavy metal contamination. This study proposes a biological digestion strategy to overcome such interference. The gene sequences for phytase (appA) from Escherichia coli (E. coli), α-amylase (amyA) from Escherichia coli (E.

pmc-12663340.title: Depression and social connectedness as mechanisms linking frailty to quality of life in older African migrants in Australia
pmc-12663340.creator: Gideon Dzando, Paul R Ward, Lillian Mwanri, Pascal Agbadi, Rachel C Ambagtsheer
pmc-12663340.description: Older Sub-Saharan African (SSA) migrants often face cumulative stressors that heighten vulnerability with age. Frailty acts as a chronic stressor that reduces quality of life, partly through its association with depression, while social networks may reduce the effect of depression on quality of life. We analysed cross-sectional data from 205 SSA migrants aged 50 years and above in Australia.

pmc-12700515.title: Smartwatch-Derived Digital Phenotypes Relate to Psychopathology Dimensions in Patients With Psychotic Spectrum Disorders: Longitudinal Observational Study
pmc-12700515.creator: Vasiliki Garyfalli, Emmanouil Kalisperakis, Alexandros Smyrnis, Marina Lazaridi, Thomas Karantinos, Asimakis Mantas, Panagiotis P Filntisis, Niki Efthymiou, Athanasia Zlatintsi, Petros Maragos, Nikolaos Smyrnis
pmc-12700515.description: BackgroundDigital phenotyping refers to the objective measurement of human behavior via devices such as smartphones or watches and constitutes a promising advancement in personalized medicine. Digital phenotypes derived from heart rate, mobility, or sleep schedule data have been used in psychiatry to either diagnose individuals with psychotic disorders or to predict relapse as a binary outcome.

pmc-13076626.title: Gallic acid antagonizes deoxynivalenol toxicity by inhibiting DON-induced ferroptosis
pmc-13076626.creator: Haorong Wang, Jiacui Xu, Jinghan Feng, Yifan Zhang, Zixian Zhao, Yan Lv, Chuanqi Wang, Jing Zhang, Yongxing Ai
pmc-13076626.description: Deoxynivalenol (DON) is a prevalent foodborne mycotoxin severely compromising livestock and poultry health and food safety. This study evaluated gallic acid (GA) —a top-performing candidate among screened polyphenols—in counteracting DON toxicity. In chicken embryo fibroblasts, 0.5 μM DON reduced viability to ~55% and induced oxidative stress, while co-treatment with 160 μM GA restored viability to ~79%.

pmc-13385405.title: Combined biosynthesis and site-specific incorporation of phenylalanine derivatives from aryl aldehydes or carboxylic acids
pmc-13385405.creator: Shelby R Anderson, Abigail P Spangler, Amanda M Forti, Michaela A Jones, Roman M Dickey, Aditya M Kunjapur
pmc-13385405.description: Applications of genetic code expansion (GCE) in live cells are widespread and continually emerging, yet they have been limited by their reliance on the supplementation of non-standard amino acids (nsAAs) to cell culturing media. Here, we report the design of a single engineered bacterial host that performs the steps of phenylalanine derivative semi-synthesis and site-specific incorporation within target proteins.

pmc-13463347.title: A Large Language Model-Based Simulation Protocol Using ChatGPT for Training Novice Critical Care Nurses in Family Crisis Communication and De-escalation
pmc-13463347.creator: Dimitrios Alefragkis, Dimitra Aloizou, Vasiliki Chougia
pmc-13463347.description: High-stress conversations with family members in distress are a common part of the intensive care unit (ICU) nursing environment. Novice critical care nurses may have limited opportunities to practice these interactions before encountering them in clinical care. Traditional simulation methods can support communication training but often require faculty time, standardized patients, programming, and specialized resources.
